description: Structured eval definitions for the ECR Replication Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across ECR replication topologies (cross-region same-account replication for DR, cross-account replication with destination registry ID, pull-through cache for docker.io upstream, multi-region DR with lifecycle policies and cost awareness, missing destination registry ID prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Cross-region ECR replication for DR (us-east-1 to us-west-2 and eu-west-1)
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — registry-level cross-region replication, ALL repos replicate, read-only replicas, 3x storage cost noted
eval_cases.prompt: Configure ECR cross-region replication for account 111122223333. Source region us-east-1. Destination regions us-west-2 and eu-west-1. We need DR coverage across three regions. All repos should replicate. Tags: Environment=production, Pattern=dr.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ECR_REPLICATION: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1) → us-west-2:111122223333, eu-west-1:111122223333
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Source registry: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Replication type: Cross-region (same account)
  [✓] Destinations: us-west-2:111122223333, eu-west-1:111122223333
  [✓] Registry scope: ALL repositories (registry-level)
  [✓] Replicated images: READ-ONLY in destination
  [✓] Storage cost: 3 regions (source + 2 destinations = 3x storage)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ecr describe-registry --region us-east-1
  aws ecr describe-repositories --region us-west-2
  aws ecr describe-repositories --region eu-west-1

eval_cases.name: Cross-account ECR replication with destination registry ID
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — cross-account replication, destination registry 999999999999, read-only replicas, destination must allow replication
eval_cases.prompt: Configure ECR cross-account replication. Source account 111122223333 in us-east-1. Destination account 999999999999 in us-east-1. We are sharing our container images with a partner account. All repos should replicate. Tags: Environment=production, Pattern=cross-account.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ECR_REPLICATION: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1) → us-east-1:999999999999
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Source registry: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Replication type: Cross-account
  [✓] Destinations: us-east-1:999999999999
  [✓] Registry scope: ALL repositories (registry-level)
  [✓] Replicated images: READ-ONLY in destination
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ecr describe-registry --region us-east-1
  aws ecr describe-repositories --registry-id 999999999999 --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: ECR pull-through cache rule for Docker Hub
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — pull-through cache for docker.io (registry-1.docker.io), prefix docker-hub/, reduces external rate limits and latency
eval_cases.prompt: Create an ECR pull-through cache rule for Docker Hub images. Use the prefix docker-hub/. Upstream registry is docker.io. We want Lambda and ECS to pull from the cached copy instead of hitting Docker Hub directly to avoid rate limits. Region us-east-1, account 111122223333. Tags: Environment=production, Upstream=docker-hub.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ECR_REPLICATION: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1) → pull-through cache
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Source registry: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Replication type: Pull-through cache
  [✓] Pull-through cache rules: docker-hub/ → registry-1.docker.io
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ecr describe-pull-through-cache-rules --region us-east-1
  aws ecr describe-registry --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Multi-region ECR replication for DR with lifecycle policies and cost control
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — replication to us-west-2 and ap-southeast-2, lifecycle policies in all regions, 3x storage cost noted, replication lag awareness for large images
eval_cases.prompt: Configure ECR replication from us-east-1 (account 111122223333) to us-west-2 and ap-southeast-2. We have large images (2-5GB) and need cost control. Apply lifecycle policies to retain only the last 30 images per repo in all regions. Tags: Environment=production, Pattern=multi-region-dr.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ECR_REPLICATION: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1) → us-west-2:111122223333, ap-southeast-2:111122223333
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Source registry: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Replication type: Cross-region (same account)
  [✓] Destinations: us-west-2:111122223333, ap-southeast-2:111122223333
  [✓] Storage cost: 3 regions (source + 2 destinations = 3x storage)
  [✓] Lifecycle policies: applied in source AND destinations
  [✓] Replication lag: expected 2-5 minutes for large images
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ecr describe-registry --region us-east-1
  aws ecr describe-repositories --region us-west-2
  aws ecr describe-repositories --region ap-southeast-2

eval_cases.name: Cross-account ECR replication without destination registry ID (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — cross-account replication requires the 12-digit destination account ID; operator does not know it
eval_cases.prompt: Configure ECR cross-account replication from account 111122223333 in us-east-1 to a partner account. I don't know the partner's AWS account ID. Just set it up. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
ECR_REPLICATION: 111122223333 (region: us-east-1) → unknown destination
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Destination registry ID: MISSING — cross-account replication requires the 12-digit destination account ID
